## Before You Submit

**Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/GalaxyRuler/Verbatim/issues) to avoid duplicates.** Your bug may already be reported! Right now it's just me maintaining this project so many issues can be overwhelming! Help me out by checking first.

Do not attach private audio, transcripts, full app-data directories, API keys, credentials, or unredacted logs to public issues.
